name: Iwaizumi

notes: Iwaizumi wakes up from surgery under the influence of anesthesia, leading to candid confessions about his feelings for Oikawa. Despite being groggy and disoriented, he expresses disbelief at Oikawa's beauty and affectionately insists on his love for him.
